frequentlyAskedQuestions.title: Frequently Asked Questions
frequentlyAskedQuestions.description: Everything you need to know about Jazzam

questions.question1: How does the AI generate leads?
questions.answer1: Jazzam collects leads from your website and campaigns (LinkedIn & Snapchat), then analyzes behavior such as visits or interactions. It classifies them (Hot – Warm – Cold) and provides next-step recommendations: call, follow-up, or ignore.
questions.answer2: Jazzam doesn’t just collect data, it analyzes and gives actionable recommendations. It integrates multiple channels, is built for Saudi Arabia, and is simple to use.
questions.question3: How does Jazzam ensure data security?
questions.answer3: Security is a priority: secure storage, full encryption, restricted access, and compliance with Saudi data policies.
questions.question4: Can I try Jazzam for free?
questions.answer4: Yes, you can start a free trial to run your first campaign and track leads immediately.
questions.question5: Does Jazzam integrate with my current systems?
questions.answer5: Yes, it integrates with CRMs, marketing tools, and allows easy export to Excel or CSV.
